title: Geometries of Quantum Field Theories
summary: This is an English translation of a book originally published in Japanese by Saiensu-sha in 2015. The book is an introduction to the 3d-3d correspondence, the relation between 3d $\mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetric gauge theories and the geometry of 3-manifolds, which arises from the compactification of the 6d $\mathcal{N}=(2,0)$ theory. The presentation is bottom-up rather than top-down: instead of starting from the 6d theory, we begin by asking what a quantum field theory is, and let the geometry emerge on its own. Along the way we discuss renormalization and low-energy effective theories,…
